title: Statistically Profiling Biases in Natural Language Reasoning Datasets and Models

bias_targets.methodology: Identifying spurious linguistic cues (e.g., specific words, sentiment polarity, tense, negation, word overlap, named entities, and typos) that statistically correlate with specific labels in NLI and multiple-choice datasets. The paper evaluates model reliance on these artifacts using hypothesis-only baseline tests, accuracy tests comparing feature-filtered vs. feature-less test sets, and distribution tests that evaluate predictions on label-flattened (neutralized) stress sets.
